import hashlib, os, stat, sys
ROOT = '/tmp/greenfield-34-final-brownfield-claude-6b1oo2_2'
if os.path.realpath(os.getcwd()) != ROOT:
    sys.exit('REFUSE: cwd is not the approved scratch root')
def refuse(msg):
    sys.stderr.write('REFUSE: ' + msg + '
')
    sys.exit(2)
def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def safe_rel(p):
    parts = p.split('/')
    if p.startswith('/') or any(s in ('', '.', '..') for s in parts):
        refuse('unsafe path ' + p)
    return p
def real_dir(p):
    try:
        st = os.lstat(p)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        refuse('missing parent directory ' + p)
    if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
        refuse('parent is not a real directory ' + p)
def check_new(p, parents):
    safe_rel(p)
    parent = os.path.dirname(p) or '.'
    if parent not in parents:
        refuse('unapproved parent ' + parent + ' for ' + p)
    if os.path.lexists(p):
        refuse('target already exists ' + p)
def check_edit(p, before):
    safe_rel(p)
    st = os.lstat(p)
    if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
        refuse('edit target is not a regular file ' + p)
    with open(p, 'rb') as f:
        actual = sha(f.read())
    if actual != before:
        refuse('before-hash mismatch for ' + p + ': ' + actual)
def write_new(p, text):
    fd = os.open(p, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o664)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(text.encode('utf-8'))
    sys.stdout.write('WRITE: ' + p + ' (new, exclusive) sha256=' + sha(text.encode('utf-8')) + '
')
def write_edit(p, text):
    fd = os.open(p, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(text.encode('utf-8'))
    sys.stdout.write('WRITE: ' + p + ' (edit, hash-guarded) sha256=' + sha(text.encode('utf-8')) + '
')
